answer_1.quote: We introduce TSVER, the first benchmark dataset for fact verification grounded in real-world time-series evidence.

answer_2.quote: In addition to standard verdict prediction metrics such as macro-F1 and accuracy, we introduce two complementary evaluation metrics to assess the effectiveness of our retrieval and justification components.

answer_3.quote: We use gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17 as the scorer model, and the prompting details can be seen in Appendix E.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a two-round annotation study using the Prolific platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to assign one of four verdict labels and to provide a justification. To assist with reasoning, we presented precomputed statistics... Annotators were asked to identify truthful ones and optionally incorporate them into their justifications.
